findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: risk_audit, diagnostic, transcribe_audio, extract_whatsapp · Private data: diagnostic, transcribe_audio, extract_whatsapp, health · Public sink: transcribe_audio · Destructive: risk_audit, diagnostic, transcribe_audio.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: risk_audit, diagnostic, transcribe_audio, extract_whatsapp · Private data: diagnostic, transcribe_audio, extract_whatsapp, health · Public sink: transcribe_audio · Destructive: risk_audit, diagnostic, transcribe_audio

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
